text:
Power Plant | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
 maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every two months as indicated by M2 in 
 the title block
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as helmet, and safety 
 shoes ...etc
Dry cloth, thermometer
Electrical equipment kit, device to detect noises
New filters if necessary
Work to be Carried Out
Record the ambient temperature.
Read and record motor temperature at bearing side and fan side and compare 
 with recommended values
Check for unusual noise from the motor.
Clean the outside motor surface.
Read the current of the motor and ensure it is within normal range
Clean or change the filter if there is a signal of ∆ P or as the manufacturer 
 recommendations,
